name: iSLCollective
description_short: A huge printable-worksheet archive — every level, every skill. Broad by nature, so metadata here is a range, not a fixed value.
teacher_note: The site itself is a mess to browse — but the printable worksheet search is genuinely fast once you know to skip the homepage.
creator: iSLCollective
internal_notes: group_fit set to unknown rather than not_applicable: unlike the FRT tools, group suitability plausibly DOES apply to worksheets on this archive, it just hasn't been assessed — a genuine data gap, not an inapplicable dimension. This is a deliberate distinction worth preserving during migration, not a default.
